passages.provision_quote: A person may not sell or transfer a firearm unless the person is a licensed firearms dealer
passages.note: Bill text requires dealer-run background checks on private sales (clause [b]); silent on whether any firearm type is banned, so clause [a] is unshown.

passages.provision_quote: A person may not sell or transfer a firearm unless the person is a licensed firearms dealer
passages.note: Referral of the same universal-checks measure to voters; same content as HB 2621, so meets clause [b] only.

rows.reasoning: Márquez prime-sponsored HB 2621 and introduced HCR 2034, whose text requires that a person may not sell or transfer a firearm unless a licensed dealer is involved, which meets 'require universal background checks on every sale'. Nothing shows he would 'allow all types of firearms' (a checks bill is silent on bans), so the compound rung is only half evidenced.
